name: Captain Numirril

abilities.name: Quick Strike
abilities.description: A basic melee attack dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Waves and Swell
abilities.description: Captain Numirril rises up on a water spout, then comes swinging down on you with his sword, dealing massive physical damage. This attack can be blocked.

abilities.name: Jet
abilities.description: Captain Numirril suddenly dashes across the screen while riding a water spout, indicated by a circular AoE beneath him, dealing high physical damage and staggering you. This often leads into Spout.

abilities.name: Wave Swat
abilities.description: Captain Numirril swats his hand in front of himself, summoning a wave of water in a wide area before him, indicated by a wide conical AoE, dealing high physical damage.

abilities.name: Spout
abilities.description: Captain Numirril summons numerous large water spouts back to back close to each other, tracking close behind your movement, indicated by circular AoEs, dealing high physical damage each.

abilities.name: Splash
abilities.description: Upon reaching 80%/40%, Captain Numirril dashes outside of the arena and rests on a tall water spout, overlooking the arena, becoming invulnerable to incoming damage. He then summons large roiling water waves across the arena, indicated by massive circular AoEs, dealing very high physical damage and knocking you back if hit.

abilities.name: Summon the Drowned
abilities.description: While still outside of the arena, Captain Numirril summons a horde of drowned enemies, comprising of Drowned Hulks, the main threat, along with Drowned Corpses and Drowned Fiends. Captain Numirril will eventually return to the arena even if the adds aren't all killed. The drowned zombies will spew bile all over the arena.

abilities.name: Bile Burst
abilities.description: Captain Numirril causes the lingering bile applied onto the arena from the drowned in the previous summoning to explode in succession, indicated by large growing circular AoEs, dealing high poison damage each.

abilities.name: Drown
abilities.description: A column of water will lift the player with aggro up unless blocked or dodged and deals moderate frost damage. It cannot be broken free from.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Za'ji
dialogue.line: Come back you scaly scallywags! You take what is rightfully Captain Za'ji's!
dialogue.trigger: When you reach the square in front of the lighthouse, the Maormer ship will be sailing away. Captain Numirril will leave the ship and move towards you in a column of water

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: Scavengers? Bah! Take the lodestones to Dreadsail Reef. I'll make sure these wretches can't follow.
dialogue.trigger: When you reach the square in front of the lighthouse, the Maormer ship will be sailing away. Captain Numirril will leave the ship and move towards you in a column of water

dialogue.line: <Both Caska and Za'ji rush at the Maormer.>
dialogue.trigger: When you reach the square in front of the lighthouse, the Maormer ship will be sailing away. Captain Numirril will leave the ship and move towards you in a column of water

dialogue.speaker: Caska
dialogue.line: I'd like to see you try—ayyy!
dialogue.trigger: When you reach the square in front of the lighthouse, the Maormer ship will be sailing away. Captain Numirril will leave the ship and move towards you in a column of water

dialogue.line: <With a gesture, Numirril sweeps Caska and Za'ji over the side into the water. Za'ji manages to get out of the water with his grappling bow>
dialogue.trigger: When you reach the square in front of the lighthouse, the Maormer ship will be sailing away. Captain Numirril will leave the ship and move towards you in a column of water

dialogue.speaker: Captain Za'ji
dialogue.line: It will take more than that playful splash to keep Za'ji from his treasure!
dialogue.trigger: When you reach the square in front of the lighthouse, the Maormer ship will be sailing away. Captain Numirril will leave the ship and move towards you in a column of water

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: Put up a good fight and I might keep your heads as trophies instead of letting the gulls pick out your eyes.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: The lodestones were ours the moment we agreed to the bargain.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: You'll soon join the rest of the flotsam bobbing on the waves.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: Five years hard labor for every Dreadsail you've killed. If the adders don't make a meal of you first.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: You picked the wrong salvage to fight for.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: Orgnum's serpents take your soul!

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: You'll soon wish you'd have drowned.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: The deep claims leviathans and holds them in its thrall. Where they are tamed, you shall be crushed!
dialogue.trigger: When he summons the first Drowned Hulk

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: You thrash and gasp like fish dumped onto the decks, soon to be snuffed out without ceremony or respect.
dialogue.trigger: Trigger? Line said during first Drowned Hulk fight while Cpt N was in the water. Doesn't replace the previous line, occurs after it.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: Did you believe the Maormer weak and the Dreadsail unworthy of your fear? We have the strength of the sea and the force of waves in our very blood!
dialogue.trigger: Trigger? Line said during first Drowned Hulk fight while Cpt N was in the water. Doesn't replace the previous line, occurs after it.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: My blood is the tides! The more you spill the more shall rise up to swallow you!
dialogue.trigger: When he summons Drowned Corpses to deal with you

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: I am Dreadsail, born of the sea. I cannot be defeated!
dialogue.trigger: During combat, when he goes back into the water the second time and summons the second Drowned Hulk

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: Sibling seas, answer me.
dialogue.trigger: When he is about to cast Drown

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: Give in, you're in the serpent's mouth.
dialogue.trigger: When Drown is not blocked or dodged

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: That's it, cease your struggles.
dialogue.trigger: When Drown is not blocked or dodged

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: Shh. Let the tide take you.
dialogue.trigger: When Drown is not blocked or dodged

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: Rise now, seas of Tamriel, wash these pitiful curs away.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: The sea obeys my command, what force have you brought to match it?

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: Hah, spewed into the drink like the swill you are!

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: The current's on my side.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: I am the crashing waves!

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: Like a shark chasing horkers.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: Let the brine fill your lungs and die!

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: Soon you'll be nothing but mouldering filth for the harbor rats!

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: Join the rest of the sodden rotters in this harbor!

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: So you land-crawlers do have teeth, but you are nothing but slaughterfish among sharks.
dialogue.trigger: Near the climax of the battle

dialogue.speaker: Captain Za'ji
dialogue.line: Hah! You won't catch Za'ji like that!
dialogue.trigger: Near the climax of the battle

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: I left my ship for this? Feh.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: Fetch the chains! One or two might have survived.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: The secret's safe now.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: Someone strip this lot of whatever they're worth.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Numirril
dialogue.line: Curse you all to the deep…!

related_quests: Wright of Passage: Help Za'ji retrieve plans to upgrade his ship from a haunted shipyard.
Pledge: Shipwright's Regret: Enter Shipwright's Regret and return Undaunted.
summary: Captain Numirril is a Maormer pirate and a captain of the Dreadsails. He is a powerful water magic user. You will encounter him in the Derelict Shipyard section of Shipwright's Regret, where he acts as the final boss of the dungeon. He has a rare chance to drop the antiquity lead for the Rune-scribed Braces mythic item fragment for Syrabane's Ward.
